   - Retail Agricultural demands (for crop irrigation)
   - Seawater Barrier demands (to prevent seawater intrusion)
   - Replenishment demands (to restore groundwater basins)

2. **Imported Supply Forecasts** – These include projections for water supplies from the State Water Project (SWP) and the Central Valley Project (CRA), incorporating historical hydrology, climate variability, and projected climate change impacts.

3. **Conservation and Storage Forecasts** – These include modeling of conservation savings and the operation of Metropolitan’s regional storage portfolio, integrated into the Integrated Resources Planning Simulation Model (IRPSIM) to evaluate reliability under varying conditions.

The function of the overall correction value of the upper thread tension is to allow the user to adjust the tension values for **all programs at once**, regardless of the individual program settings. This provides a convenient way to uniformly increase or decrease the upper thread tension across all sewing programs without having to modify each one individually.

When the overall correction value is set, it is **added to the base tension value** of each program during sewing. This means the effective tension applied during sewing is the sum of the program’s original tension value and the overall correction value — even if the TENSION indicator is turned off. This feature is particularly useful for making global adjustments to thread tension for different materials or sewing conditions without reconfiguring each program separately.

As noted in the document:  
> “The upper thread tension which matches the overall correction value which has been set for the upper thread tension will be applied during sewing, regardless of whether the TENSION indicator is illuminated or switched off.”  
> Example: If the base tension is set to “76” and the overall correction is “+5”, the actual tension applied will be “81”.

This ensures consistent tension adjustments across all programs while maintaining flexibility for fine-tuning individual programs as needed.
